items.summary: # OpenBB V5 Changelog OpenBB V5 is the new major-version line of the kept packages under `openbb_platform/` and `cli/`. The `openbb` metapackage is now 5.0.0; the core, CLI, API, MCP server, routers and most providers are 2.0.0; exceptions include openbb-devtools (1.6.8 -> 2.0.1), openbb-charting (3.0.0 -> 4.0.0) and openbb-imf (2.1.3 -> 2.1.2 -> 3.0.0). The repository license changed from AGPL-3.0-only to Apache-2.0 in [#7677](https://github.com/OpenBB-finance/OpenBB/pull/7677), in the root `LICENSE`, every `pyproject.toml` and the desktop app. Eighteen directories present on develop are absent on v5 (sixteen provider packages, the openbb-regulators extension and the test-only `extensions/famafrench` tree); one provider, openbb-jodi 2.0.0, is new. Headline changes: hatchling/uv packaging, the `openbb-core[pandas]` extra, ruff and ty, layered `openbb.toml` config, `OBBStream` streaming, decoupled charting, CLI 2.0 with `.spec` files and codegen, spec-driven platform-api and MCP proxies, provider-owned routers with conditional registration, 16 provider refactors plus the new openbb-jodi provider, package 2.0 releases, the `openbb` 5.0.0 metapackage, charting 4.0, refreshed extension catalogs and a root-package publishing workflow. The root `openbb` metapackage was migrated from Poetry 4.7.3 to hatchling/PEP 621 version 5.0.0 in direct commit `6d8e44100ab`; its dependencies now…
